desc: FRONT VIEW: the character faces the camera and runs straight TOWARD the viewer (down the screen), never turning sideways. Make it a real fast run: body leaning forward toward the camera, knees driving high, alternating legs with a flight phase, arms pumping, sword carried low in the right hand. Keep the exact same character, face, long black hair, black coat with gold trim, red cape lining, gold pauldron and size. No effects, no smears.
